notes.title: Update version 1.1.3!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.3 has been released!
Some minor bugs has been fixed and the jump system has been improved, so during battles you can now jump behind the enemies even better! XD

But there is also one more news: Our Hero! Two is coming!
After one year of development and some breaks, the sequel of Our Hero! First is coming in October 2021!
Stay tuned, the release date will be announced soon ;)
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1408050/Our_Hero_Two/]Wishlist Our Hero! Two now[/url]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0: multi language support is here!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.0 of Our Hero! First has been released!
This new version introduces some minor bug fixes, many improvements and most important the multi language support!

We have the game available in 2 languages now: English and Italian.
More languages will be added over time, Spanish in the first place!

You can select and change your preferred language from the main menu.
Everything is translated: all game dialogues, weapons, skills, items and location names!

We hope you'll enjoy this new version of Our Hero! First!
See you soon :)

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2 is here + we started working on Multi Language support
notes.notes:
Today is releasing patch 1.0.2 for Our Hero! First! This patch introduces little general improvements and minor bug fixes for an even smoother and better in-game experience!

However the biggest news is about multi language support: the support for more languages other than English is under development!
The first language that will be introduced will be Italian, followed by Spanish thanks to a collaboration with Nicolas Eyaralar (thank you!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32664625/cdb205bb5439684856621c524b4b613fa744911a.gif[/img]

Stay tuned and if you are interested to have the game translated in your language, just send me a message. We can probably find a deal and collaborate together to make it! :)
